summary: At 390 px, the primary Homebrew install command is visibly clipped. The desktop comparison also uses bar lengths that do not match the labeled values.

findings.description: [defect] On mobile, the Homebrew install command cuts off after `kestrel-trace/ta` beside the Copy button, hiding part of the package path. Let the command wrap or give it a full-width row so readers can see it in full.

[defect] In the desktop ingestion benchmark, the 4,800 ms bar spans about one-third of the track and the 340 ms bar spans about 4%. Neither is proportional to the same endpoint of the 6,000–18,000 ms range shown with a full-width bar. Use a shared scale and show the range as an interval.

[defect] The desktop memory chart gives Cloud SaaS APM a hatched bar about half the track width but labels it only `エージェント常駐`. The bar implies a numeric memory value. Keep the text status and omit the bar.
[defect] The mobile profiler badge wraps `プロファイラ` with only the final `ラ` on the second line. Adjust the badge copy or line break to keep the word together.
